definitions.meaning: slang for a term served in prison
an act of extending or spreading out

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses of one word: a prison sentence in slang, and an extending or lengthening.

clue.text: Part of a lock that holds water

definitions.meaning: the pivoting piece inside a lock that a key lifts into place
a drinking glass, a vessel for water

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the lever in a lock mechanism, and a flat-bottomed drinking glass.

indicators.note: translated means the letters of the word poems are turned into a new form

explanation.surface: A course in rendering poetry from one language into another.
explanation.definitionFit: Epsom is an English racecourse, home of the Derby, so it is a course for horse racing.

clue.text: Top quality work produced by pupils in college, initially

parts.note: a class is a group of pupils taught together

indicators.note: initially means the opening letters of the words in and college are taken

explanation.surface: An excellent piece of work turned in by students at a college.
explanation.definitionFit: A classic is a work of lasting excellence, an acknowledged masterpiece.

definitions.meaning: to further a cause is to promote or help it on
to progress is to move forward

explanation.definitionFit: Both verbs mean to move or help forward, which is what advancing does.

clue.text: My dear, it can be quite unpractical!

indicators.note: it can be suggests the letters of my dear may be rearranged into another word

explanation.surface: Someone affectionately telling a loved one they can be rather impractical.
explanation.definitionFit: A dreamy person has their head in the clouds, so is impractical and lost in fancies.

parts.note: at a knighting the monarch touches the shoulder with a sword, a gesture of royal honour

explanation.surface: Moving shows of gratitude from a monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Touching' reads as moving or emotional, but the original accolade was a literal touch of the sword on the shoulder when conferring a knighthood.
explanation.definitionFit: Accolades are honours or praise, originally the ceremonial touch bestowing knighthood.

clue.text: Is a good man able to get a game?

parts.note: to be able is to be capable, so can
ST, short for saint, is the crossword good man

explanation.surface: Asking whether a decent fellow will manage to join in a match.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces come in a different order from the clue: 'able' gives CAN first, then 'a', 'good man' ST and the second 'a'.
explanation.definitionFit: Canasta is a rummy-style card game played with two packs.

parts.note: one who goes straight lives honestly, and also, literally, does not turn

explanation.surface: Someone who plainly has not drifted into lawbreaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not turning' plays on straight as the opposite of bending, while the phrase is also the idiom for a reformed criminal living honestly.
explanation.definitionFit: Going straight is the idiom for a former offender living an honest life.

clue.text: Current assertion of private secretary status

definitions.note: amps are units measuring electrical current, so plural stands for current

parts.note: I am is an assertion of being, giving the word am
PS is the standard abbreviation for private secretary

explanation.surface: An official claiming their present standing as a personal assistant.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the result as 'am PS', a person asserting the status of private secretary; 'of' and 'status' join the pieces. 'Current' looks like 'present', but it is electric current.
explanation.definitionFit: Amperes measure electric current, so the word stands for current by metonymy.

clue.text: Youngster's grants in a foreign currency

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, linking the definition to the wordplay

indicators.note: in means the grants go inside the letters made by a and the foreign currency

parts.note: a cent is a coin of the US and euro, foreign from a British view
doles are handouts or grants, as in the dole

explanation.surface: A young person's allowances being paid in some overseas money.
explanation.definitionFit: An adolescent is a teenager, a young person between childhood and adulthood.

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so many
limbs are members of the body, arms and legs

explanation.surface: Advances in rank achieved for numerous people in an organisation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Members' suggests people in a club, but it means body parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Climbs and rises are both verbs for going upward.

indicators.note: travelling means the letters of salesmen move about into a new order

explanation.surface: Sales reps on the road whose names are unknown.
explanation.definitionFit: Something nameless has no name given, which is to be anonymous.

clue.text: Wide variety of actors giving a sound performance

parts.note: wide means broad
the cast is the assorted company of actors in a show

explanation.surface: A diverse troupe of performers putting on a solid show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like 'good', but it means heard: a radio programme.
explanation.definitionFit: A radio broadcast is a programme heard over the air, a performance in sound only.

indicators.note: in means the letters of I'm are set inside those made by a and race

parts.note: a nation is a people or race
taken as written, the letters IM

explanation.surface: A competitor at the start of a race, about to set off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Go' seems to be the starter's word, but it is the noun meaning vitality.
explanation.definitionFit: Animation is liveliness or vigour, the quality called go or zip.

clue.text: Thought leading lady to be perfect

parts.note: an idea is a thought

indicators.note: the first letter of the word it picks from

parts.note: the first letter of lady is L

explanation.surface: Thinking that the star actress is flawless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leading lady' looks like a star of the stage, but it gives just the opening letter of lady.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideal as an adjective means perfect, matching an imagined standard.

clue.text: Join in a very loud number

parts.note: FF, fortissimo, is the musical marking for very loud
IX is the Roman numeral nine

explanation.surface: An invitation to join in a song sung at full volume.
explanation.definitionFit: To affix is to attach or fasten, which is to join one thing to another.

definitions.meaning: stuff means cloth, and ... is a soft woollen fabric
British slang for evasive or empty talk

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a woollen cloth, and in British use evasive waffle or blather.

indicators.note: damaged means the letters of sideboard are knocked into a new shape

explanation.surface: A piece of furniture wrecked by an attack.
explanation.definitionFit: A broadside is the simultaneous firing of all guns on one side of a ship, a bombardment.

clue.text: Lover of Theseus gives song with uplifting finale

parts.note: an aria is a song in opera

indicators.note: uplifting in a down clue means the word is read from the bottom up

parts.note: a finale is the end

explanation.surface: A mythical hero's beloved singing a piece with a rousing close.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uplifting' turns END to DNE in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Ariadne helped Theseus escape the Minotaur's labyrinth and was his lover.

parts.note: a difficulty that arises from having to pick between options

explanation.surface: A predicament over which option to pick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Of choice' can read as 'preferred', a favourite problem, but here it means a problem about choosing.
explanation.definitionFit: A dilemma is a situation demanding a choice between equally unwelcome alternatives.

clue.text: Excellent to include it, within limits

indicators.note: to include means the word it is placed inside the other piece

parts.note: fine means excellent

explanation.surface: Approving of something so long as it stays within bounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Finite means bounded, having limits, so it describes something within limits.

clue.text: Pain and gain makes a great violinist

indicators.note: makes signals that the letters of pain and gain together form something new

explanation.surface: Suffering and progress produce a virtuoso, as in no pain, no gain.
explanation.definitionFit: Niccolo Paganini was a celebrated Italian virtuoso violinist and composer.

indicators.note: the question mark is the only signal here, warning that the word Sunlit is not to be read straight but rearranged

explanation.surface: A face reddened by sunshine.
explanation.walkthrough: There is no anagram word: the question mark warns that 'Sunlit' is to be rearranged. 'Cheek' looks like part of the face but means rudeness.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheek is impudence or rude talk, and an insult is a rude remark.

indicators.note: cut here means the end letter is clipped off the word for hard

parts.note: severe means hard or harsh

explanation.surface: An instruction to a barber or editor to trim drastically.
explanation.definitionFit: To sever is to cut through or apart.

clue.text: Incomplete description of a Schubert composition

definitions.meaning: Schubert's Symphony No 8 is known by a nickname because he left it with only two movements

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: incomplete, and the nickname of Schubert's two-movement Eighth Symphony.

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five
taken as written

explanation.surface: Making do using an electrical fuse rated at five amperes.
explanation.walkthrough: '5-amp fuse' looks like an electrical part; split it to V (Roman five) plus AMP, with 'fuse' simply joining them.
explanation.definitionFit: To vamp is to improvise, especially an accompaniment in music.

definitions.meaning: a bed covering used when going to bed

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: comprehensive in scope, and a woollen bed cover used at bedtime.

definitions.meaning: flight means running away or withdrawing
departure means going away or leaving

explanation.definitionFit: Both nouns name a withdrawal; a retreat is a pulling back from a position.
